## 2. Revision disposition

The manager should preserve scientific contract version `v0.1` and advance only the rendered document revision from `r0.3` to proposed `r0.4`. The revision shall preserve exactly `SCI-MAP-REQ-001` through `SCI-MAP-REQ-052` and `SCI-MAP-PRED-001` through `SCI-MAP-PRED-025`.

No append-only normative requirement or prediction identifier is needed. Every new handoff obligation fits without identity change in an existing upstream-input, admission, response, covariance, validity, provenance, consumer, or immutable-parent clause. Adding such an identifier would duplicate those established obligations rather than express a genuinely new scientific surface. `PTC-HANDOFF-R0.1`, `profile_instance_id`, predicate keys, and test handles introduced below are versioning, state-identity, manifest, or non-normative test labels; they do not append a requirement, prediction, owner-decision, or scientific-contract identifier. The profile revision is unavoidable because two scoped predicate meanings must not share one evaluable identity.

The bounded scientific effects are:

1. Ordinary SCI-MAP begins only from a realized PTC-transformed Stokes-I timestream and its exact realized PTC identities and facts. There is no ordinary direct CAL-to-MAP route.
2. Required-product PTC availability gates the observation route; occurrence availability is a distinct contribution predicate. Preserved producer eligibility, flag-precedence, calibration-validity, and non-finite facts and MAP-owned predicates are also required, so no availability state is sufficient. MAP authors the exact versioned admission profile for the named map use; VAL may register and evaluate that profile but does not author or extend it.
3. ALIGN/AST continue to own realized sample-coordinate facts. MAP owns the target map grid and projection operation. Projection class, normalization, and boundary-loss policy remain open.
4. A typed unavailable response does not by itself invalidate the raw map. Response-dependent claims fail closed; another use is response-independent only through an exact owner-authorized versioned dependency binding, never by omission.
5. Missing or incomplete covariance does not by itself invalidate the raw map. Covariance-dependent claims fail closed, and unknown terms are not zero.
6. Later response, covariance, or response-corrected products are new versioned derivatives bound to exact raw MAP, PTC, and evidence parents; they do not rewrite the raw map or its claims.
7. `independent_exposure` is component- or product-aspect-specific. Replacement of the signal component does not rewrite the response component's origin or universally invalidate the paired occurrence.

The revision does not decide projection class, projection normalization, boundary-loss treatment, the numerical domain or boundary-case disposition of `coverage_cut`, abstract observation-map publication policy, Pointing/OOF mode registration, canonical common-grid preparation, or future reprojection/mosaicking ownership.

## 3. Definitions, notation, equations, and assumptions

### 3.1 Exact replacement definitions

Insert the following definitions before the ordinary-map equations. These definitions replace the prior direct calibrated-input premise while preserving the existing equation numbering.

> Let \(i=(t,d)\) identify one candidate occurrence in an exact realized PTC product \({\cal P}_i\). Let \(x_i^{\rm PTC}\), in `mJy/beam`, be that product's realized PTC-transformed Stokes-I signal member. The transformed timestream is the authoritative PTC-to-MAP intermediate on the ordinary route and is not an independent sky estimator. Let \(\omega_i^{\rm PTC}\) be the member of the exact explicitly named PTC analysis/gridding coefficient family admitted for MAP; it is not a loading, centering/scaling parameter, diagnostic, or unnamed coefficient. Let \(q_i^{\rm AA}\) denote the realized ALIGN/AST coordinate fact with its frame, time, astrometric identity, validity, cause, uncertainty, and response state. Let \({\cal G}_{\rm MAP}\) be the MAP-owned operation that maps admitted \(q_i^{\rm AA}\) into coefficients \(G_{pi}\) on the declared MAP-owned target grid. Every realized product records the actual projection class, normalization, extent, and boundary convention. This notation asserts no projection class, no law such as \(\sum_pG_{pi}=1\), and no boundary-loss treatment.

> Let \(A_{\cal P}^{\rm PTC}\) be the producer-owned availability state of the required realized PTC product and \(A_i^{\rm PTC}\) the producer-owned availability state of occurrence \(i\) within an available product; each retains a typed cause when unavailable. Product availability and occurrence availability are distinct scopes. Let \(\Pi_{\rm MAP}^{0.1}\) denote the MAP-authored base profile with semantic identity `{name: SCI-MAP:map_upstream_admission, contract_version: v0.1, profile_revision: PTC-HANDOFF-R0.1}`. One realized profile instance additionally binds the immutable effective-plan identity and the complete ordered predicate manifest, including every predicate key, version, source binding, evaluation scope, failure scope, and required/optional status. Its `profile_instance_id` is the SHA-256 of the canonical serialization of those fields. Let \(c_{pi}^{\rm MAP}\) be the typed contribution-scope result for occurrence \(i\) and target pixel \(p\), and define \(m_{pi}^{\rm MAP}=1\) if and only if \(c_{pi}^{\rm MAP}=\mathrm{admit}\). VAL may register and evaluate this exact profile instance; it does not author the profile, invent a missing predicate, infer a universal consequence from a cause name, alter a failure scope, or promote a PTC-unavailable product or occurrence.

> Let \(\rho_M\) be the response state of a MAP product. It is either `available`, with source, exact MAP and PTC parent identities, meaning, domain, normalization, uncertainty, and limitations, or `unavailable(cause)`. Let \(\kappa_M\) be the covariance representation state: `persisted`, `lineage-resolvable`, `summarized`, or `unavailable(cause)`, with meaning, domain, assumptions, omitted terms, and limitations. Availability of \(\rho_M\) or a complete \(\kappa_M\) is claim-dependent; a well-typed unavailable state is not a numerical zero and is not by itself raw-map invalidity.

| Realized instance identity | The instance records the exact named ordinary-map use, immutable effective-plan identity, ordered predicate manifest, and `profile_instance_id = SHA-256(canonical(base identity, effective-plan identity, complete bound manifest))`. No predicate may be added, omitted, rebound, or re-scoped without changing this identity. |

A product route-gate failure is not per-occurrence noncontribution and cannot be overridden. |

A failure at one of those scopes shall fail or leave unsupported that exact product/claim before mutation; it shall not be coerced to \(m_{pi}^{\rm MAP}=0\) or silently change \(C_p\). For the `profile_instance_id`, `canonical(...)` is the UTF-8 encoding, with no byte-order mark or insignificant whitespace, of the exact JSON object `{"name":"SCI-MAP:map_upstream_admission","contract_version":"v0.1","profile_revision":"PTC-HANDOFF-R0.1","effective_plan_id":E,"predicate_manifest":[P_1,...,P_n]}`. `E` is the exact immutable effective-plan identity as a JSON string. The manifest order is normative. Each `P_j` is the exact JSON object `{"key":K,"version":V,"source_binding":S,"evaluation_scope":E_s,"failure_scope":F_s,"required":B}` with keys in that order, `K`, `V`, `S`, `E_s`, and `F_s` JSON strings, and `B` the JSON boolean `true` or `false`. Strings use standard JSON escaping and no optional escaping. SHA-256 is computed over those bytes and recorded as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Evaluation outcomes and causes are realized state and are recorded beside, but are not input to, the instance identity.

The bound manifest shall contain the route and contribution keys from the table in their displayed order. An effective plan may append only a predicate already authorized by the v0.1 contract, and it shall record that predicate's exact normative source in `source_binding`; the new instance identity then changes. A new unowned scientific predicate, a changed base meaning, or a changed default or failure scope is not an effective-plan option and requires the applicable owner decision and profile revision or contract change.

This author return defines the profile semantics but makes no claim that VAL or any implementation has registered or evaluated it.

Every response-bearing claim shall also bind an immutable response-dependency record with `claim_id`, `claim_owner`, `claim_version`, exact product or consumer identity, `response_requirement` equal to `not_required` or `required`, and a declared failure scope. A `required` record additionally names the sufficient response source class, parent identity, template or meaning, domain, normalization, uncertainty/limitation requirements, and any combination rule. Omission is never interpreted as `not_required`: an unbound claim remains unsupported and fails closed if attempted. The raw map's existence, signal value on its authorized rows, and raw validity explicitly require a well-typed response state but not response availability. Any other claim is response-independent only when its scientific owner binds `not_required` in the exact versioned record. This closed-world binding rule replaces the ledger's request for an informal restricted-consumer list if, and only if, the scientific owner adopts the OD-003 disposition in Section 6.1.

Every covariance-bearing claim shall bind an analogous immutable covariance-dependency record with claim identity/owner/version, product or consumer identity, `covariance_requirement` equal to `not_required` or `required`, sufficient meaning, parentage, domain, representation, assumptions, omitted-term limits, combination rule, and failure scope. Omission never means independence, and a required but unavailable or insufficient representation leaves the claim unsupported or fails closed at its declared scope without changing raw validity or contribution membership. This claim-binding rule does not choose the minimum covariance representation that every raw bundle must persist; that storage question remains OD-004.

### 3.2 Exact equation changes

Replace Equations (1) and (2) with the following, preserving their numbers:

\[
  a_{pi}=G_{pi}\,\omega_i^{\rm PTC}, \tag{1}
\]

\[
  A_{\cal P}^{\rm PTC}=\mathrm{available}\ \Longrightarrow
  C_p=\left\{i:\ A_i^{\rm PTC}=\mathrm{available},\ m_{pi}^{\rm MAP}=1,
  \mathrm{finite}(x_i^{\rm PTC}),\ \mathrm{finite}(G_{pi}),
  \mathrm{finite}(\omega_i^{\rm PTC}),\ a_{pi}>0\right\},\qquad
  m_{pi}^{\rm MAP}=1\iff c_{pi}^{\rm MAP}=\mathrm{admit}. \tag{2}
\]

Equation (2) separates the observation-product route gate from occurrence/pixel contribution conditions. If \(A_{\cal P}^{\rm PTC}\ne\mathrm{available}\), no \(C_p\) or MAP product is constructed. Within an available product, \(A_i^{\rm PTC}\ne\mathrm{available}\) makes only that occurrence noncontributing unless a separately authorized broader-scope gate says otherwise; MAP never infers a broader failure from the cause name. Occurrence availability and the preserved upstream eligibility, flag-precedence, calibration-validity, signal, coefficient, coordinate, projection, and boundary keys cannot substitute for one another, and MAP cannot promote a failed key. A product-, observation-, coadd-, or consumer-scoped gate is not a term in \(m_{pi}^{\rm MAP}\): its failure propagates at its declared scope before mutation and shall not silently remove samples from \(C_p\). An explicitly disabled PTC request, an invalid PTC rank, or any otherwise unavailable required PTC product supplies no ordinary MAP input and produces no MAP product. A scientifically neutral PTC configuration still realizes and identifies \({\cal P}\); it does not create a direct CAL-to-MAP branch.

Replace the signal symbols in Equation (4) by \(x_i^{\rm PTC}\), without otherwise changing the accumulator or support-row algebra:

\[
  N_p=\sum_{i\in C_p}a_{pi}x_i^{\rm PTC},\qquad
  Q_p=\sum_{i\in C_p}a_{pi}. \tag{4}
\]

Replace the qualification on Equation (5) with:

> When an exact versioned response-claim binding is present and a sample-domain tracer \(k_i\) satisfies its source, parent, template/meaning, domain, normalization, uncertainty, and limitation criteria, \(K_p=\sum_{i\in C_p}a_{pi}k_i\). When the binding is absent or the tracer is unavailable or insufficient, no numerical \(K_p\) or zero-valued substitute is created for that claim; the response state and exact cause remain explicit. This product/claim outcome does not alter \(C_p\).

Replace the prose and symbols surrounding Equation (9) with:

\[
  R_{\rm out}=A_{\rm out}H,\qquad
  \mathrm{E}[\widehat{x}_{\rm out}\mid\Theta]
    =R_{\rm out}s+A_{\rm out}\mu_0,\qquad
  C_{x,\rm out}=A_{\rm out}N_{\rm PTC}A_{\rm out}^{T}. \tag{9}
\]

> Here \(N_{\rm PTC}\) is the conditional error covariance of the exact processed PTC-transformed input, not the ensemble covariance of sky plus error and not an assumption of independence. The complete state \(\Theta\) includes exact PTC product and coefficient identities, PTC availability and causes, MAP admission-profile identity and result, ALIGN/AST coordinate facts, MAP grid and projection facts, membership, response, covariance, geometry, support, and parentage. Equation (9) defines conditional scientific objects on the exact selected rows. It does not assert that a response realization or complete covariance representation is available or persisted. A claim requiring either object is unsupported while the required information is unavailable.

Keep Equations (3), (6)-(8), (10)-(24), and the threshold equations unchanged. In Equation (25), retain the covariance propagation and replace the response qualification with:

> \(R_{c,\rm out}=B_{\rm out}T\) is asserted only when an exact versioned coadd response binding is present and the admitted observation response states and their combination metadata satisfy it. Otherwise the coadd records `unavailable(cause)` or insufficient response and does not fabricate a numerical response. Likewise, \(C_{c,\rm out}=B_{\rm out}C_{\rm obs}B_{\rm out}^{T}\) remains the exact conditional equation; an unbound, unavailable, or incomplete \(C_{\rm obs}\) leaves a required covariance claim unsupported and is never replaced by zero blocks. Neither outcome changes observation contribution membership.

### 3.3 Raw-validity replacement definition

Replace every narrative expansion of final raw validity by this exact definition:

> On row \(p\), authoritative final raw validity requires membership in the exact effective support-authorized row set, admitted exact PTC and MAP product identity, a passing contribution-scope MAP result, every applicable support predicate, finite normalized signal, every companion that the exact effective-product binding designates numerically required, well-typed response and covariance states, and no product-level failure. Response availability and complete covariance availability are not unconditional validity conjuncts. Product- and consumer-scoped gates never become silent contribution exclusion. A claim-specific consumer fails closed at its declared scope if its exact versioned binding requires response or covariance information that is unavailable or insufficient.

### 3.4 Derivative-parent rule

Insert this unnumbered rule in the response/covariance and immutable-parent discussions:

> A later response estimate, covariance estimate, or response-corrected map is a new versioned product. It records the exact raw MAP parent, exact realized PTC parent, simulation or evidence product where applicable, source class, applicable domain, assumptions, uncertainty, and limitations. It neither mutates the raw MAP product nor enlarges the claims recorded for that raw parent.

## 4. Exact canonical requirement replacements

The following clauses are the complete exact replacement wording for every affected existing requirement. Requirements not listed in this section remain word-for-word unchanged.

**SCI-MAP-REQ-001 - Versioned authority.** The scientific contract version shall remain v0.1. The rendered document revision for this bounded PTC-handoff revision shall be recorded separately as r0.4; changing layout or exposition alone shall not be represented as a new scientific contract version.

**SCI-MAP-REQ-002 - Capability and PTC-transformed input.** The ordinary input shall be an available required realized PTC-transformed Stokes-I timestream product in `mJy/beam`, with exact product identity, membership, distinct product and occurrence availability states, preserved producer eligibility/flag/calibration facts, signal, coefficient, causes, response, covariance, and provenance. The PTC-transformed timestream is an intermediate and not an independent sky estimator. An explicitly disabled PTC request, invalid PTC rank, or otherwise unavailable required realized PTC product shall produce no ordinary MAP product and shall not select a direct CAL-to-MAP fallback. A scientifically neutral PTC configuration shall still realize and retain its PTC product identity.

**SCI-MAP-REQ-003 - Explicit identity.** Every candidate contribution shall carry explicit observation, array, network when applicable, map-group, Stokes, realized PTC product, PTC signal member or input-column, exact PTC analysis/gridding coefficient-product, and occurrence/product-scoped detector-acquisition identity. Container position, row equality, a local key, or numerical equality with an upstream value alone shall not establish scientific identity.

**SCI-MAP-REQ-004 - PTC availability and MAP-owned admission.** An available required realized PTC product shall be the observation-product route gate; within it, an available PTC occurrence and every applicable preserved producer sample/detector eligibility, flag-precedence, calibration-validity, and non-finite fact shall be necessary but not sufficient for ordinary MAP contribution. Product and occurrence availability shall remain distinct typed scopes: product unavailability terminates the MAP route, while occurrence unavailability is cause-specific noncontribution unless a separately authorized broader-scope gate applies. SCI-MAP shall author the base profile `{name: SCI-MAP:map_upstream_admission, contract_version: v0.1, profile_revision: PTC-HANDOFF-R0.1}`. Each realized profile instance shall bind the immutable effective-plan identity and complete ordered predicate manifest, including every predicate key, version, source binding, evaluation scope, failure scope, and required/optional state, and shall carry a `profile_instance_id` equal to the SHA-256 of their canonical serialization. SCI-MAP shall preserve producer facts and causes and shall not promote a failed product, occurrence, eligibility, flag, calibration, or non-finite state. VAL may register and evaluate the exact instance but shall not author it, invent or omit a predicate, change a binding or failure scope, change its versioned meaning, or infer universal eligibility from a producer cause.

**SCI-MAP-REQ-005 - Coordinate and projection authority.** ALIGN/AST shall own the realized sample sky coordinates and their frame, time, astrometric identity, validity, causes, uncertainty, and response state. SCI-MAP shall own the target map grid and the operation that maps admitted coordinates into finite projection coefficients \(G_{pi}\), including the actual projection class, normalization, extent, and boundary convention recorded by each realized product. SCI-MAP shall not invent a missing coordinate, wrap, clamp, or assert an unrecorded conservation law. This requirement does not authorize a projection class, a normalization law, or a boundary-loss treatment.

**SCI-MAP-REQ-006 - PTC analysis/gridding coefficient status.** Each admitted \(\omega_i\) shall belong to the exact explicitly named realized PTC analysis/gridding coefficient family facing MAP. That family shall declare its indices, statistic or factors, domains, unit, normalization, support, lifecycle, consumers, numerical use, and prohibited interpretations, and shall remain distinct from PTC loadings, centering/scaling parameters, and diagnostics. Each admitted ordinary coefficient shall be finite and strictly positive. Zero is noncontributing; negative and non-finite ordinary coefficients are invalid. Re-estimation shall create a new realized PTC coefficient-product state and identity.

**SCI-MAP-REQ-007 - Exposure meaning and component independence.** Every exposure contribution shall be finite and nonnegative in a named unit and accounting convention. Detector-seconds shall not be labeled wall-clock integration time without an explicit multiplicity normalization. For a paired signal/response occurrence, `independent_exposure` shall be evaluated for the explicitly named component or product aspect. Replacement of the signal value shall not count as an independent signal measurement, shall not rewrite the response component's origin, and shall not by itself universally invalidate the pair.

**SCI-MAP-REQ-008 - Response state and claim binding.** Every MAP product shall carry either available response information with source, exact MAP and PTC parent identity, meaning, domain, normalization, uncertainty, and limitations, or an explicit typed `unavailable(cause)` state. Any PTC response fact and any sample-domain tracer shall retain its source and parent identity. A PTC map-center or compact-source response shall not establish a general response or transfer MAP response authority beyond its exact declared domain. Every attempted response-bearing claim shall bind an immutable owner, claim ID/version, response requirement, sufficient source/parent/domain/normalization/uncertainty/limitation criteria, and failure scope; an omitted or insufficient binding fails closed. A numerical sentinel or zero array shall not represent unavailability. Response unavailability alone shall not invalidate an otherwise admitted raw map or prohibit later scientific analysis, but every response-dependent claim or consumer shall fail closed until its bound sufficiency criteria pass.

**SCI-MAP-REQ-009 - Immutable plan and lifecycle.** The accepted request shall be immutable and shall resolve one way through requested, effective, observation-resolved, and realized states. Observation-resolved state shall bind the exact required-product and occurrence PTC availability facts, preserved producer eligibility/flag/calibration facts, realized PTC signal and coefficient products, MAP base-profile revision, effective-plan identity, complete scoped predicate manifest, `profile_instance_id`, per-predicate results and causes, response- and covariance-dependency records, ALIGN/AST coordinate facts, target grid, projection metadata, required companions, and provenance. Disabled expert values shall remain inactive; one observation's resolved state shall not leak into another; execution and later derivative products shall not rewrite the request or any realized parent.

**SCI-MAP-REQ-010 - Contribution predicate and scoped gates.** After the required realized PTC product passes its observation-product route gate, the estimator contribution set for each pixel shall be fixed before payload accumulation by exact contribution-scope keys for PTC occurrence availability; preserved producer sample/detector eligibility, flag precedence, and calibration validity; PTC signal identity and finiteness; PTC analysis/gridding coefficient identity and finite positive state; ALIGN/AST coordinate state; and MAP projection and boundary state. The typed aggregate result shall satisfy \(m_{pi}^{\rm MAP}=1\) if and only if \(c_{pi}^{\rm MAP}=\mathrm{admit}\), with every predicate outcome and cause recorded. Required companions and predicates at pixel, observation, coadd, complete-product, or consumer scope shall be evaluated separately and shall fail or leave unsupported that declared product/claim before mutation; they shall not be coerced into per-occurrence noncontribution or silently alter \(C_p\). No product, occurrence, producer fact, MAP predicate, or cause name alone shall determine MAP admission or a broader failure scope.

**SCI-MAP-REQ-011 - Ordinary accumulators.** On the fixed contribution set, SCI-MAP shall accumulate the pre-normalized signal numerator \(N_p=\sum_i a_{pi}x_i^{\rm PTC}\), normalization \(Q_p=\sum_i a_{pi}\), and, only when an exact response-claim binding is present and a response tracer satisfies its source, parent, template/meaning, domain, normalization, uncertainty, and limitation criteria, response numerator \(K_p=\sum_i a_{pi}k_i\), where \(a_{pi}=G_{pi}\omega_i^{\rm PTC}>0\). An unbound, unavailable, or insufficient response shall remain explicit and shall not create a numerical \(K_p\) or alter the fixed contribution set.

**SCI-MAP-REQ-012 - Normalized publication.** The scientific normalized signal vector shall contain exactly the rows \(p\in S_{\rm out}\) authorized by the applicable effective support policy. On those rows a finite \(Q_p>0\) gives \(\widehat{x}_p=N_p/Q_p\); when an exact response-claim binding is present and the response information satisfies it, the same rows give \(\widehat{k}_p=K_p/Q_p\). An unbound, unavailable, or insufficient response shall not be represented by zero and shall not by itself remove an otherwise valid signal row or change contribution membership. Accumulators or storage slots may exist elsewhere, but no unsupported row, zero-filled value, or sentinel is a normalized scientific output or measured zero sky.

**SCI-MAP-REQ-016 - Same operator for linear companions.** Signal, every response/kernel tracer sufficient for its exact claim binding, and every declared linear realization shall use the same admitted membership, MAP-owned geometric placement, coefficients, and exact support-authorized output-row selection. An unbound, unavailable, or insufficient companion shall retain its typed state, domain, and cause rather than a zero-valued realization and shall not alter signal contribution membership. Retained exposure and coadd observation count shall use the same membership and placement wherever their component-specific definitions require them.

**SCI-MAP-REQ-017 - Realized and later response claims.** A stored kernel may be called the realized response to template \(\tau\) only when an exact owner-authorized claim binding is present, its sample parent satisfies \(k=H\tau\), the support-restricted map product satisfies \(\widehat{k}=A_{\rm out}H\tau=R_{\rm out}\tau\) on exactly the authorized rows, and its source, raw MAP/PTC parents, meaning, domain, normalization, uncertainty, and limitations satisfy that binding. Otherwise it shall be labeled tracer, insufficient for the claim, or `unavailable(cause)`. A later response estimate, including a simulation-derived estimate, and any response-corrected map shall be new versioned products bound to the exact raw MAP parent, PTC parent, evidence product, source class, and domain; neither shall rewrite the raw product or its claims.

**SCI-MAP-REQ-019 - Conditional covariance.** For fixed complete state \(\Theta\), the authoritative ordinary conditional error covariance on the exact support-authorized row set shall be \(C_{x,\rm out}=A_{\rm out}N_{\rm PTC}A_{\rm out}^{T}\), retaining consequential cross-pixel terms among those rows. It is conditional on exact realized PTC signal and coefficient products, PTC and MAP admission state, calibration, coordinates, projection, response, geometry, and support policy; no zero-filled extension is scientific covariance. The equation does not assert that a complete covariance representation is available or persisted.

**SCI-MAP-REQ-022 - Covariance representation and claim boundary.** The bundle shall declare the covariance information it actually provides, its meaning, domain, assumptions, representation as persisted, lineage-resolvable, summarized, or `unavailable(cause)`, omitted temporal, detector, cross-pixel, cross-observation, calibration, astrometric, response, and additive-bias terms, and limitations. Every attempted covariance-bearing claim shall bind an immutable owner, claim ID/version, covariance requirement, sufficient parent/domain/representation/assumption/omitted-term/combination criteria, and failure scope; omission never defaults to covariance independence. Absence of a complete covariance model shall not by itself invalidate an otherwise admitted raw map or prohibit later scientific analysis. A claim with an unbound, unavailable, or insufficient required covariance shall remain unsupported or fail closed at its declared scope, and unknown terms shall not be treated as zero. A later covariance estimate shall be a new versioned product bound to the exact raw MAP and PTC parents and applicable domain; it shall not rewrite the raw product's claims. This rule does not decide OD-004's minimum persistence representation.

**SCI-MAP-REQ-023 - Data-derived state and re-estimation.** If membership, PTC coefficients, MAP admission, response, covariance, or geometry are estimated or selected from the same data, the displayed linear expectation and covariance shall remain explicitly conditional; unconditional bias or covariance requires a named joint model or resampling result outside this fixed-state claim. Re-estimation or later estimation shall create a new realized product state with exact parentage rather than mutate the identity or claims of an earlier PTC or MAP product.

**SCI-MAP-REQ-025 - Eight distinct facts.** Every raw bundle shall separately represent geometric projected incidences over the declared population of available PTC occurrences passing the applicable preserved producer eligibility, flag-precedence, calibration-validity, and coordinate predicates; estimator-admitted contributions under the remaining exact MAP-owned contribution profile; admitted observation count for coadds; upstream-eligible exposure; retained exposure; numerical normalization support; science-policy support; and authoritative final raw science validity. Product availability, occurrence availability, response, and covariance representation states shall be explicit bundle facts but shall not become aliases for one another or for raw validity. No fact shall become authority for another.

**SCI-MAP-REQ-026 - Geometric incidences.** Within an available required PTC product, geometric projected incidences shall count available candidate occurrences passing the applicable preserved producer eligibility, flag-precedence, calibration-validity, and ALIGN/AST coordinate predicates whose declared coordinates touch a pixel under the product's actual MAP-owned projection class and explicit fractional-projection counting convention, before MAP-specific coefficient rejection. The count shall not infer a projection normalization law, promote a failed producer fact, or conflate occurrence unavailability with product-route failure.

**SCI-MAP-REQ-027 - Estimator contributions.** Estimator-admitted contributions shall count exactly the entries in the ordinary contribution set within an available required PTC product whose occurrences are available and whose preserved producer eligibility, flag-precedence, calibration-validity, signal, coefficient, coordinate, projection, and boundary keys all pass the exact MAP-owned named-use profile. They shall exclude unavailable occurrences and zero, negative, non-finite, upstream-ineligible, flagged, calibration-invalid, profile-rejected, and out-of-bounds candidates while preserving each distinct state, cause, and scope.

**SCI-MAP-REQ-029 - Upstream-eligible exposure.** Within an available required PTC product, upstream-eligible exposure shall sum the named exposure measure over available occurrences passing the applicable preserved producer eligibility, flag-precedence, calibration-validity, and coordinate predicates before MAP-specific coefficient rejection, according to its declared exposure projection and explicitly named component or product aspect. It shall preserve product/occurrence availability scope and every applicable producer fact and cause.

**SCI-MAP-REQ-030 - Retained exposure.** Retained exposure shall sum the same named exposure measure over entries admitted by the exact MAP-owned named-use profile and their declared placement. It shall be evaluated for the explicitly named component or product aspect and shall not be labeled precision.

**SCI-MAP-REQ-033 - Authoritative raw validity.** One raw science-validity state shall require membership in the exact support-authorized output-row set, exact admitted PTC and MAP bundle identity, a passing MAP contribution result, every applicable support predicate, finite normalized signal, finite companions designated numerically required by the exact effective-product binding, well-typed response and covariance states, and absence of a product-level failure. Response availability and complete covariance availability shall not be unconditional validity conjuncts. Product- and consumer-claim gates shall not be folded into contribution membership. A retained slot, finite payload, positive coefficient, exposure, hit count, support plane, compatibility alias, or response/covariance availability state alone shall not make a pixel valid.

**SCI-MAP-REQ-036 - Complete observation bundle.** An observation map shall be one immutable ordered bundle containing signal, numerator, normalization identity, distinct required-product and occurrence PTC availability states, preserved producer eligibility/flag/calibration facts, exact realized PTC signal and analysis/gridding coefficient parents, MAP base-profile revision, effective-plan identity, complete scoped predicate manifest, `profile_instance_id`, per-predicate outcomes and causes, response- and covariance-dependency records, response state, conditional uncertainty state, all eight facts where applicable, units, frame/WCS, target-grid and projection metadata, shape/indexing, estimator, lifecycle, provenance, causes, and exact product identity. A typed unavailable response or incomplete covariance does not make the bundle structurally incomplete when no exact effective product or claim binding requires the missing numerical information.

**SCI-MAP-REQ-037 - Atomic coadd admission.** A complete observation bundle shall pass all identity, compatibility, MAP-profile-instance, and exact claim-required companion gates before any coadd-owned state changes. Each gate shall record its evaluation scope, failure scope, outcome, and cause. A well-typed unavailable response or incomplete covariance shall cause rejection only when the exact versioned coadd product or claim binding requires that missing information. A product- or claim-scoped failure shall not be converted into per-occurrence noncontribution or alter an observation's \(C_p\). Rejection shall leave numerators, normalizations, counts, exposure, response, covariance, validity, provenance, and product cardinality unchanged.

**SCI-MAP-REQ-040 - Coadd companions and unavailable states.** When an exact versioned coadd claim binding requires or asserts available response, its response/kernel shall use the same atomic admission, centered-integer placement, coefficients, and exact support-authorized output-row selection as coadd signal, with input response source, parent, meaning, domain, normalization, uncertainty, limitations, and combination rule sufficient for that binding. Otherwise the coadd response shall be `unavailable(cause)` and no zero response shall be fabricated; this state alone shall not invalidate a signal coadd whose exact owner-authorized binding does not require response. Retained exposure and admitted observation count shall use the same admission and placement, and the count shall increment once per admitted complete bundle at each applicable pixel.

**SCI-MAP-REQ-041 - Coadd covariance and precision.** For fixed admission and support-restricted coadd operator \(B_{\rm out}\), the exact conditional covariance equation shall be \(C_{c,\rm out}=B_{\rm out}C_{\rm obs}B_{\rm out}^{T}\), including consequential cross-observation blocks among authorized rows. An unavailable or incomplete covariance shall limit a claim whose exact owner-authorized dependency record requires more information, without by itself invalidating the signal coadd; omission of a dependency binding does not default to independence, and unknown blocks shall not be set to zero. Summed observation coefficients equal coadd precision only for independent unbiased maps of the same unit-gain estimand weighted by their true marginal inverse variances.

**SCI-MAP-REQ-043 - Minimum product identity.** Every observation and coadd product shall identify role, external observation or coadd identity, array and group, network/detector occurrence when applicable, Stokes I, distinct required-product and occurrence PTC availability states, preserved producer eligibility/flag/calibration facts, exact realized PTC signal and coefficient parents, MAP base-profile revision, immutable effective-plan identity, complete scoped predicate-manifest identity, `profile_instance_id`, per-predicate outcomes and causes, response- and covariance-dependency records, estimator, response state/version, covariance representation state/version, signal unit, frame, full WCS, target-grid and actual projection class/normalization/extent/boundary metadata, pixel shape/order, raw and derivative parentage, causes, and product identity.

**SCI-MAP-REQ-046 - Realized provenance.** Realized state shall record executed observations and groups; distinct required-product and occurrence PTC availability states and causes; exact preserved producer eligibility, flag-precedence, calibration-validity, signal, coefficient, response, covariance, and provenance facts; MAP base-profile revision, immutable effective-plan identity, complete predicate manifest with source/evaluation/failure scopes, `profile_instance_id`, every per-predicate outcome and cause, response- and covariance-dependency records and outcomes; admitted contributions and bundles; target-grid and actual projection metadata; accumulators; exact observation and coadd support-authorized output-row sets; all eight facts; response and covariance representation states; centered-integer offsets; completed required products; failures; and exact requested, effective, resolved, raw-parent, and derivative-parent identities.

**SCI-MAP-REQ-047 - Failure scope and atomicity.** An explicitly disabled PTC request, invalid PTC rank, or otherwise unavailable required realized PTC product shall produce no ordinary MAP product and no direct CAL-to-MAP fallback. Within an available product, a producer-owned unavailable occurrence is contribution-scope noncontribution and shall not be promoted to product-route failure by its cause name; only a separately authorized broader-scope gate may change that scope. Any other invalid required input, failed MAP-owned admission predicate, incompatible bundle, unrepresentable finite aggregate, unrepresentable coordinate/index conversion, missing companion required by an exact effective-product or consumer-claim binding, or failed required publication shall propagate at its manifest-declared contribution, pixel, observation-admission, coadd, complete-product, or consumer scope and shall fail before live state changes at that scope. A failure outside contribution scope shall not be represented as \(m_{pi}^{\rm MAP}=0\) or silently alter \(C_p\). A well-typed unavailable response or incomplete covariance shall not be promoted to a product failure when the exact versioned product and claim bindings do not require the missing information.

**SCI-MAP-REQ-049 - Immutable raw and upstream parents.** Downstream transformations and later response, covariance, or response-corrected products shall preserve resolvable exact raw MAP and realized PTC parent identities and the authoritative raw validity state. Each later result shall have a new versioned product identity and applicable domain. It shall not rewrite raw validity, alter the raw parent's claims, sever provenance, or promote a raw-invalid pixel through a consumer-local validity alias.

**SCI-MAP-REQ-050 - Complete claim-gated consumer boundary.** No consumer shall receive a bare signal plane as a scientifically complete map. The boundary shall include exact realized PTC parents and causes, MAP base-profile and realized-instance identities, immutable effective-plan and complete scoped predicate-manifest identities, per-predicate outcomes and causes, estimator/normalization identity, response state, response- and covariance-dependency records, conditional covariance state and assumptions, eight facts, additive-bias/null-mode state, units, frame/WCS, target-grid and projection metadata, shape/indexing, grouping, lifecycle, parentage, dependency versions, and failures. An unbound claim is neither response-independent nor covariance-independent by default. Response or covariance unavailability shall limit consumers and exact versioned claims according to their bindings; each required but unavailable, unbound, or insufficient claim shall fail closed at its declared scope without invalidating the raw map by inference or changing raw contribution membership.

**SCI-MAP-REQ-051 - Same fixed noise operator.** An admitted noise realization may be described as using the same map/coadd operator only when exact realized PTC product identity, MAP base-profile revision, immutable effective-plan and predicate-manifest identities, `profile_instance_id`, per-predicate results, eligibility, projection, grouping, coefficients, normalization, exact support-authorized row selection, boundary, and atomic coadd admission are fixed or identically prescribed. Re-estimation of PTC state, MAP admission, projection state, or other operator state from randomized data shall define a different named estimator and realized product.

## 5. Exact falsifiable-prediction replacements

The following clauses are the complete exact replacement wording for every affected existing prediction. Predictions not listed in this section remain word-for-word unchanged. These are proposed conformance challenges or algebraic consequences, not executed validation evidence.

**SCI-MAP-PRED-005 - Delta input.** When the exact versioned basis-pixel claim binding is present and response source, parent, template, domain, normalization, uncertainty, and limitations satisfy it, a basis-pixel sky input produces the corresponding support-row-restricted column of \(R_{\rm out}=A_{\rm out}H\), including the declared projection and boundary behavior; it need not be a delta in the output map, and no value is predicted outside the authorized rows. When the binding is absent or response information is insufficient, no numerical delta-response claim or zero substitute is produced. Primary claim layer: Representation fidelity.

**SCI-MAP-PRED-006 - Point-source template.** When the exact versioned point-source claim binding is present and response source, parent, template \(\tau_b\), domain, normalization, uncertainty, and limitations satisfy it, the predicted output is \(R_{\rm out}\tau_b\) on exactly the support-authorized rows; peak, integrated, and fitted amplitudes are distinct functionals and require separately bound criteria. An absent binding or unavailable or insufficient response leaves each claim unsupported rather than zero. Primary claim layer: Representation fidelity.

**SCI-MAP-PRED-007 - Resolved and Fourier inputs.** When an exact versioned claim binding exists and response source, parent, template, domain, normalization, uncertainty, and limitations satisfy it for each declared input, resolved disks, gradients, and Fourier modes produce their explicit \(R_{\rm out}\tau\) on the authorized row set; a constant-input pass does not predict preservation of these modes. An absent binding or unavailable or domain-insufficient response supplies no numerical prediction for them. Primary claim layer: Representation fidelity.

**SCI-MAP-PRED-008 - Variable coverage.** Fixed-coefficient constant preservation can coexist with spatially varying normalization, support-row membership, conditional covariance, and, when response information is available, nonconstant-template response; a row that fails support is absent rather than measured zero. Response or complete-covariance unavailability limits only the corresponding claims. Primary claim layer: Algebraic contract.

**SCI-MAP-PRED-009 - Finite boundary.** At an admitted finite edge, no contribution wraps or clamps; local normalization may preserve a constant. When sufficient response information exists, compact-source peak or integrated response may differ from its interior value under the declared boundary convention. Without that information, no edge-response value is asserted or fabricated. Primary claim layer: Representation fidelity.

**SCI-MAP-PRED-010 - PTC coefficient states.** Only the exact explicitly named realized PTC analysis/gridding coefficient family may face ordinary MAP. Loadings, centering/scaling parameters, diagnostics, and unnamed coefficient families are rejected even if numerically finite. Within the admitted family, zero coefficients add no estimator contribution, low positive coefficients follow the adopted support policy, and negative and non-finite ordinary coefficients are invalid and cause-specific. Re-estimation produces a new realized PTC product identity. Primary claim layer: Engineering conformance.

**SCI-MAP-PRED-011 - PTC route, producer facts, and MAP admission.** An explicitly disabled PTC request, invalid PTC rank, or otherwise unavailable required realized PTC product produces no MAP product and no direct CAL-to-MAP fallback. Within an available product, an unavailable occurrence contributes nowhere without aborting the product solely from its cause name. An available occurrence still contributes nowhere unless the preserved producer sample/detector eligibility, flag-precedence, calibration-validity, and non-finite predicates and the exact remaining MAP-owned named-use profile pass. Upstream-ineligible, flagged, calibration-invalid, non-finite, profile-rejected, and out-of-bounds candidates do not contaminate an accumulator because they are excluded before payload evaluation; states, causes, and scopes remain distinct. Primary claim layer: Engineering conformance.

**SCI-MAP-PRED-013 - Missing or insufficient response.** A missing response parent yields a typed `unavailable(cause)` response state, never a fabricated zero response. A response whose source, parent, meaning, domain, normalization, uncertainty, or limitations do not satisfy the exact versioned claim binding is insufficient for that claim and is not promoted to general MAP authority. The otherwise admitted raw map can remain raw-valid. A claim is response-independent only when its scientific owner binds `response_requirement=not_required`; omission never defaults to independence. Every required but unavailable, unbound, or insufficient response fails closed at the binding's declared scope. A later response estimate or response-corrected map has a new versioned identity bound to the exact raw MAP, PTC, and evidence parents and does not rewrite the original product or its claims. Primary claim layer: Engineering conformance.

**SCI-MAP-PRED-014 - Atomic scoped rejection.** Any incompatible identity, unit, WCS, shape, policy, parent, or companion required by an exact effective-product or consumer-claim binding fails at its manifest-declared pixel, observation, coadd, complete-product, or consumer scope before state at that scope is changed. A product- or claim-scoped failure is not converted to \(m_{pi}^{\rm MAP}=0\), does not silently alter \(C_p\), and does not partially change coadd accumulators or counts. A well-typed unavailable response or incomplete covariance does not by itself reject a signal-only coadd whose exact owner-authorized binding records that information as not required; the missing-information state remains explicit and no zero substitute is created. Primary claim layer: Engineering conformance.

**SCI-MAP-PRED-015 - One-observation coadd.** A coadd containing one admitted observation with positive coefficient reproduces that observation's signal exactly on the corresponding centered-integer rows authorized by both the observation and coadd support policies and creates no unsupported scientific row. If an exact versioned coadd response binding exists and sufficient compatible response information satisfies it, the coadd reproduces the available response on those rows. Otherwise it preserves a typed unavailable or insufficient response state and makes no numerical response claim; an attempted required claim fails at its bound scope. Primary claim layer: Algebraic contract.

**SCI-MAP-PRED-017 - Missing or invalid observation.** An unsupported observation row contributes at no coadd row; an incompletely admitted observation contributes nowhere and does not increment admitted-observation count. An explicitly disabled, invalid-rank, or otherwise unavailable required realized PTC product produces no observation map to admit. An unavailable occurrence within an available PTC product is excluded at contribution scope and does not by itself abort the product. None of these cases creates a zero-valued scientific substitute, promotes a failed producer fact, conflates failure scopes, or selects a CAL-to-MAP fallback. Primary claim layer: Engineering conformance.

**SCI-MAP-PRED-019 - Cross-observation covariance.** For two maps with variances \(\sigma_1^2,\sigma_2^2\) and covariance \(c\), the minimum-variance coefficients depend on \(c\); summing marginal normalizations is not precision unless the required independence and calibration conditions hold. If \(c\) or another required covariance term is unavailable, it is not set to zero and the covariance-dependent precision claim remains unsupported, while the otherwise admitted signal map need not become raw-invalid. Covariance comparison uses the exact support-authorized observation and coadd rows. Primary claim layer: Algebraic contract.

**SCI-MAP-PRED-020 - Fixed noise operator.** A deterministic admitted realization propagated with fixed exact PTC product, MAP base-profile revision, immutable effective-plan and complete predicate-manifest identities, `profile_instance_id`, per-predicate results, membership, projection, grouping, coefficients, normalization, boundary, support-row identities, and atomic coadd state yields the same coefficient-by-coefficient \(A_{\rm out}\) and \(B_{\rm out}\) as the signal path. Re-estimated PTC, admission, or projection state exposes a new named estimator and realized product difference. Primary claim layer: Engineering conformance.

**SCI-MAP-PRED-023 - No validity or parent promotion.** A downstream or later response, covariance, filtered, or corrected product may have its own local validity and claims but cannot change an inherited raw-invalid pixel to raw-valid, change the raw parent's recorded claims, sever exact raw MAP or PTC parent identity, or mutate the earlier product. Primary claim layer: Engineering conformance.

## 7. Scientist-facing narrative replacements

The scientist-facing view shall preserve the existing explanations outside the bounded delta. Use the following exact replacement passages for affected narrative surfaces.

### 7.1 Cover and at-a-glance input/output statement

> Ordinary SCI-MAP v0.1 consumes an available required realized PTC-transformed Stokes-I timestream product in `mJy/beam`, its distinct product/occurrence availability, preserved producer eligibility/flag/calibration, exact signal and analysis/gridding coefficient, cause, response, covariance, coordinate, and provenance facts. The transformed timestream is an intermediate rather than an independent sky estimator. MAP applies an exact realized instance of `{name: SCI-MAP:map_upstream_admission, contract_version: v0.1, profile_revision: PTC-HANDOFF-R0.1}`, bound to the immutable effective plan and complete scoped predicate manifest, and its MAP-owned target-grid projection operation before the fixed positive-coefficient normalized estimator. Contribution results and product/consumer gates have separate recorded scopes. A scientifically neutral PTC configuration still realizes a PTC product. Disabled PTC, invalid PTC rank, or an otherwise unavailable required realized PTC product produces no MAP product and never selects a direct CAL-to-MAP fallback.

> The output is a complete immutable raw observation-map bundle and, when requested and admissible, a complete centered-integer common-grid observation coadd bundle. Every product carries explicit response and covariance representation states. Typed response unavailability or incomplete covariance limits only claims requiring the missing information and does not by itself invalidate the raw signal map. Later response, covariance, and response-corrected results are new versioned derivatives with exact raw MAP, PTC, and evidence parentage.

### 7.2 Scientific boundary and estimand

> The ordinary observation map estimates the positive-coefficient weighted average of the admitted realized PTC-transformed sample quantity in each declared map pixel. Its conditional meaning is inherited through the exact PTC product and provenance chain, preserved producer sample/detector eligibility, flag-precedence, calibration-validity and non-finite facts, ALIGN/AST coordinate facts, and the MAP-authored named-use admission profile. Required PTC product availability is the observation-product route gate; occurrence availability is a separate contribution key. Neither is sufficient, and an occurrence cause alone does not abort an available product. MAP owns the target grid, projection operation, and map-use predicates; VAL may register and evaluate the exact profile instance but does not author or alter it. Each instance binds the effective-plan identity and complete predicate keys, versions, source bindings, evaluation scopes, failure scopes, and outcomes. A product- or consumer-scoped failure never becomes silent sample rejection. Producer facts and causes remain distinguishable, and no cause name alone supplies a universal downstream consequence.

### 7.3 Projection paragraph

> ALIGN/AST own the realized sample sky coordinates, frames, timing, astrometric identity, validity, causes, uncertainty, and response state. MAP owns the target map grid and the operation that turns admitted coordinates into \(G_{pi}\). Each product records the actual projection class, normalization, extent, and boundary convention. This ownership assignment does not select one-hot or fractional projection, require \(\sum_pG_{pi}=1\), choose another normalization, or decide how boundary loss is represented; those remain SCI-MAP-OD-008.

### 7.4 Response paragraph

> Every MAP product states what response information it actually carries and identifies its source, raw MAP and PTC parents, meaning, domain, normalization, uncertainty, and limitations, or it carries `unavailable(cause)`. A PTC map-center or compact-source response does not establish a general response or transfer MAP response authority outside its exact domain. A stored kernel is a realized response only when its sample parent and exact row identity establish \(\widehat{k}=A_{\rm out}H\tau=R_{\rm out}\tau\). Every other attempted response-bearing claim binds an owner, claim ID/version, response requirement, sufficient source/parent/domain/normalization/uncertainty/limitation criteria, and failure scope. Omission never defaults to response independence. Missing or insufficient information never becomes a zero or general response. Response unavailability alone does not invalidate the otherwise admitted raw map; every required but unavailable, unbound, or insufficient claim fails closed. A later response estimate and any corrected map are new versioned derivatives and do not rewrite the raw parent.

### 7.5 Covariance paragraph

> The exact conditional covariance equation is \(C_{x,\rm out}=A_{\rm out}N_{\rm PTC}A_{\rm out}^{T}\) on the support-authorized rows. The bundle reports the covariance information it actually provides, its domain, assumptions, representation, omitted terms, and limitations. A missing complete covariance model does not invalidate the signal map, but a covariance-dependent claim remains unsupported, and unknown correlations are never treated as zero. A later covariance estimate is a new versioned derivative. The minimum covariance representation that must persist remains SCI-MAP-OD-004.

### 7.6 Eight-fact and exposure paragraph

> The eight existing facts retain their separate identities. Within an available required PTC product, geometric incidence and upstream-eligible exposure begin from available occurrences passing the applicable preserved producer eligibility, flag-precedence, calibration-validity, and coordinate predicates; estimator-admitted contribution and retained exposure additionally require the remaining exact MAP-owned contribution profile. Product and occurrence availability remain different scopes. `independent_exposure` is evaluated for the named signal, response, or other product aspect. Replacing the signal component is not an independent signal measurement, but it does not rewrite response origin or automatically invalidate the physical paired occurrence. None of these facts is response availability, covariance completeness, precision, or final raw validity.

### 7.7 Coadd paragraph

> Coaddition still consumes complete immutable observation bundles and still uses only the existing centered-integer compatible-grid placement. A well-typed unavailable response or incomplete covariance causes atomic rejection only when an exact owner-authorized effective-product or claim binding requires that information. Signal coaddition may proceed with the missing-information state explicit only when its exact versioned binding records that information as not required; omission does not grant permission. An available coadd response and covariance use the same admitted bundles, placement, coefficients, and exact selected rows as signal. No unavailable response or unknown covariance block is replaced by zero, and no product/claim failure is converted into sample noncontribution.

### 7.8 Identity, lifecycle, and downstream paragraph

> Product identity and realized provenance include distinct required-product and occurrence PTC availability states and causes; preserved producer eligibility, flag-precedence, calibration-validity, signal, and coefficient facts; MAP base-profile revision; immutable effective-plan and complete scoped predicate-manifest identities; `profile_instance_id`; per-predicate outcomes and causes; response- and covariance-dependency records; ALIGN/AST coordinate parents; MAP target-grid and actual projection metadata; response and covariance representation states; and exact raw and derivative parentage. Re-estimation or any predicate, binding, or scope change creates a new realized product state and identity. Downstream response, covariance, filtered, fitted, or corrected products may make local claims but cannot mutate raw validity, alter the raw parent's claims, or sever the raw MAP or PTC parent chain.

### 7.9 Failure paragraph

> Disabled PTC, invalid PTC rank, or an otherwise unavailable required realized PTC product ends the ordinary MAP route with no MAP product and no CAL fallback. Within an available product, an unavailable occurrence or a failed preserved producer eligibility, flag-precedence, calibration-validity, non-finite, or MAP contribution key is excluded at contribution scope with its state and cause; no cause name alone promotes it to product failure. Missing response or covariance is a typed claim limitation, not automatically a product failure. When an exact effective-product or consumer-claim binding requires missing or insufficient information, it fails closed at its manifest-declared scope before mutation. A product- or consumer-scoped failure is never recoded as per-occurrence noncontribution and never silently changes the estimator population.

### 7.10 Open-decision paragraph

> Eight scientific-owner decisions remain open: OD-001, OD-002, OD-004, OD-005, OD-006, OD-007, OD-008, and OD-009. OD-003 is proposed resolved only through the owner-adopted closed-world response-dependency rule: raw-map existence and validity require a typed response state but not availability; every other claim must bind `not_required` or exact sufficiency criteria and failure scope, and omission fails closed. OD-004 remains open only on minimum covariance persistence and consumer sufficiency. OD-008 remains open on projection class, normalization, and boundary-loss policy after assigning ALIGN/AST coordinate ownership and MAP target-grid/projection ownership. No other owner question changes.
